items.why: Nvidia soars 30% as the board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and chip stocks jump with it.
The Nasdaq roars back by 6% and the S&P 500 rebounds 4%, so the fear gauge is collapsing as stocks recover.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq surges 6.5% as Nvidia soars on Huang's return, with the S&P 500 rebounding 4%.

market_note: Futures are higher, with Nasdaq futures up 6.4% and the VIX down 25.22%.
summary: Stocks are roaring back in a relief rally, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The Nasdaq is up about 6.5% and the S&P 500 up 4% as buyers step back in after the slide.
